en: An old sepia-toned postcard view over a spa-town landscape with villas and guesthouses surrounded by trees and gentle hills. In the foreground stands a prominent multi‑storey building with timber-framed decorative gables and a small tower, labeled as a specific establishment. The lower margin of the card carries printed captions identifying the place and publisher, along with a year.
